messages:
Emma (Support): looping in RevOps/Billing — Helios Pharma (acct HP-992) says procurement will not accept an invoice unless their PO number appears in the invoice description using their format `HP-PO-YYYY-XXXX`. They also require our W-9 and SAP vendor code before they process payment. Customer asked us to hold issuing the official invoice until they send the PO. Screenshot attached. Can Billing hold or should we issue a pro-forma?

Nate (RevOps): do we have a signed SOW/contract for this customer? if yes we can generate a pro-forma invoice to help them, but legal/billing approval needed to alter invoice date. tagging Julia. @Julia (Billing)

Julia (Billing): we can put the invoice on hold in our system and produce a pro-forma. Finance needs the vendor code + W-9 to map to their AP. timeline?

Emma (Support): customer says "they won't process payment unless PO is on file" and wants invoice date to match PO issue date. target is EOD Fri from their procurement team. They also said our legal name must be "Redwood Inference, Inc." and include EIN.

Nate (RevOps): ok — Emma please confirm account id and attach the signed SOW and the legal name/EIN. If PO arrives after we issue, we'll need to reissue or add a credit memo — prefer to wait if it's within customer timeline.

Julia (Billing): I can set a manual hold and create a pro-forma for their AP contact. I'll need sales to confirm final billing amount and billing contact email. Maria?

Maria (Sales): confirmed amount and SOW. Billing contact is accounts.payable@heliospharma.com. I've uploaded the customer's vendor requirements doc and attached our W-9. :white_check_mark:

FinanceBot: Action logged — ticket FIN-4827 created to hold the invoice until PO is received. Assigned to Julia (Billing).

Emma (Support): thanks — I'll message the customer that we will hold the invoice and send a pro-forma immediately so they can begin processing. Reopen thread if PO lands earlier or if procurement asks for any extra docs.
